method: Use four minutes of common-clock, unchanged-owner observations. Regress physical time and frozen same-case reference work against elapsed wall time. Compare total reference work, mean work per occupied stream and each common task/actual-volume class. Also require higher raw total if lower owners continue or workload proportions match. Record raw physical s/wall s for every stream.

storage_strata.with_personal: Keep the original mixed-volume measurements and their rejected widths.
storage_strata.scratch: All live and newly admitted streams record on D57 scratch. Start at three measured streams. Before the first trial freeze actual W58 B2 original and P2-private recovered A/B scratch curves, at least 30 s per recovery curve. Apply the same 240 s and 90% criteria. No cap or conclusion is transferred between strata.
